title: An injective abelian sheaf on the small etale site is an injective abelian presheaf
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], $\mathrm{PAb}(X_{\Et})$ the abelian category of presheaves of abelian groups on $X_{\Et}$ (contravariant functors to abelian groups, with natural transformations) and $\Ab(X_{\Et})\subset\mathrm{PAb}(X_{\Et})$ the full subcategory of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. If $\mathcal I$ is an injective object [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$, then $\mathcal I$, regarded as a presheaf, is an injective object of $\mathrm{PAb}(X_{\Et})$. (Stacks states this for any site.)
